if (NOT CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 8 OR
    NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "^(AMD64|amd64|x86_64|X86_64)$")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "The bundled LuaJIT libraries require x64")
endif()

if (WIN32)
    set(LUAJIT_RELEASE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/windows-x64/lua51.lib")
    set(LUAJIT_DEBUG "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/windows-x64-debug/lua51.lib")
elseif (CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
    set(LUAJIT_RELEASE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/linux-x64/libluajit.a")
    set(LUAJIT_DEBUG "${LUAJIT_RELEASE}")
else()
    message(FATAL_ERROR "The bundled LuaJIT libraries support Windows and Linux")
endif()

foreach(ARCHIVE IN ITEMS "${LUAJIT_RELEASE}" "${LUAJIT_DEBUG}")
    if (NOT EXISTS "${ARCHIVE}")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing prebuilt LuaJIT archive: ${ARCHIVE}")
    endif()
endforeach()

add_library(LuaJIT::LuaJIT STATIC IMPORTED GLOBAL)
set_target_properties(LuaJIT::LuaJIT PROPERTIES
    IMPORTED_CONFIGURATIONS "DEBUG;RELEASE"
    IMPORTED_LOCATION "${LUAJIT_RELEASE}"
    IMPORTED_LOCATION_DEBUG "${LUAJIT_DEBUG}"
    IMPORTED_LOCATION_RELEASE "${LUAJIT_RELEASE}"
    MAP_IMPORTED_CONFIG_RELWITHDEBINFO RELEASE
    MAP_IMPORTED_CONFIG_MINSIZEREL RELEASE
    INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/include")
if (CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
    target_link_libraries(LuaJIT::LuaJIT INTERFACE ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS} m)
endif()
